newsitem.title: FRANCE: Results of weekly EU grain tender detailed.
newsitem.headline: Results of weekly EU grain tender detailed.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted the following export licences for free-market grain, grain traders said.
The refunds agreed by the EU's cereals management committee in Brussels are in Ecus per tonne.
France's grain office ONIC later confirmed these figures, adding the EU also granted the export of 5,000 tonnes of EU rye from the open market at a maximum refund of 31.09 Ecus per tonne.
The EU also sold around 9,000 tonnes of German intervention barley at a minimum price of 101.50 Ecus per tonne for export to countries outside the EU, traders said.
The EU's cereals management committee in Brussels also sold 21,180 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 100.13 Ecus per tonne, they said.
It also raised the daily refund applying to exports of wheat flour and durum wheat semolina to 17 Ecus per tonne from a previous 10 Ecus, ONIC said.
